name: C64 Hardware Memtest ROM
description: Standalone diagnostic ROM. KERNAL bank holds the test code (boots, prints test results to screen); BASIC bank holds known sentinel bytes at fixed addresses. No shell, no plugins beyond system/usb. Use to bisect BASIC vs KERNAL bus problems on real hardware -- expected vs actual values are shown for bank, walking-1, walking-0, KERNAL sanity, and a 1000-read transient scan.
